cohort: The study included all pregnant women who underwent diagnostic laparoscopy for suspected adnexal torsion between March 2011 and April 2020 at a tertiary medical center, with a comparison group of pregnant women who did not undergo laparoscopy.
finding: Pregnancy outcomes among women who underwent laparoscopy for a suspected adnexal torsion during pregnancy were reassuring, irrespective of the surgical findings or gestational week, and did not differ from pregnant women who did not undergo laparoscopy.
mod_finding: Delivery characteristics, including mode of birth, did not differ between women with confirmed adnexal torsion, those where AT was ruled out, or the control group.
gest_age: Measured at delivery as an outcome
